Common Questions

Can I walk in without a booking?

Yes, walk-ins are welcome. Evenings (5–8 PM) are busy, so a WhatsApp booking saves your waiting time.

How can I pay?

Cash and all major cards are accepted — Visa, Mastercard and contactless payment.

Is female staff available for women?

Yes, female staff is available and there is a separate private section for women.

Do you give home service?

Home service is available for bridal and family packages. Please ask on WhatsApp.

How to use these in a pitch: send the client the sample that matches their business (salon, dental, restaurant or gym), then offer the same design with their real name, photos, prices and number — draft first, pay later.

This is a demo sample

This page holds sample websites made to show local business owners how their own website can look — a hair salon, a dental clinic, a restaurant and a gym. All names (“Sharma Hair Salon”, “BrightSmile Dental Clinic”, “The Olive Table”, “PowerHouse Gym”), photos, prices, reviews, phone numbers and addresses are samples only — no real number or address is used. For a real business, the same clean design will carry that shop's real name, photos, price list, timings and contact number, plus a Google Business Profile so customers can find it on Maps.
